As we redefined levels with a goal to have an easier entry level, there is a need to review levels for requirements to match that direction.

It has taken quite some time and effort, but with Josh, we went through the issues and had many discussions over changes and matching the new direction.

Do not throw everything out all at once and provide it in a more readable, manageable, and discussable way, I'll open an issue per chapter to cover (only) requirements with level changes.

Note, that level changes are compared to current requirements in bleeding edge version (not compared to release v4.0.3)

Level definitions in the document are waiting for some updates as well.
https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x03-Using-ASVS.md

The rough principles to keep in mind when analyzing levels:

  * Level 1
    * Really-really must have, without that you can not be secure
    * First layer of defense - if this is the only requirement not satisfied in the application, you still have a usable security hole (it means - no preconditions)
  * Level 2
    * Midground
  * Level 3
    * Advanced level, defense in depth
    * Niche technology
